# Parse Simple Note data for cover letter template and potential employers

token_simple = simple_note_login['access_token']
cover_note_id = 3084
emp_note_id = 3085

cover = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=cover_note_id, access_token=token_simple)
emp_note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=emp_note_id, access_token=token_simple)

template = cover['content']
emp_text = emp_note['content']

# Extract company and email from lines like: Company Name -- email
entries = []
for line in emp_text.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if '--' not in line:
        continue
    company, email = line.split('--', 1)
    company = company.strip()
    email = email.strip()
    if company and email:
        entries.append({'company_name': company, 'email': email})

print('Extracted potential employers:', len(entries))
for e in entries:
    print(e)

# Locate CV attachment under ~/documents/work/
token_fs = file_system_login['access_token']
cv_list = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=token_fs, directory_path='~/documents/work/', substring='cv', entry_type='files', recursive=True)
print('CV candidate files:', cv_list)
cv_path = None
for p in cv_list:
    if p.lower().endswith('.pdf'):
        cv_path = p
        break
if not cv_path and cv_list:
    cv_path = cv_list[0]

print('Selected cv_path:', cv_path)

# Compose per-recipient email bodies
subject = 'Application for Employment'
if not cv_path:
    raise RuntimeError('No CV file found to attach.')

composed = []
for e in entries:
    body = template.replace('{company_name}', e['company_name'])
    composed.append({
        'to': e['email'],
        'company_name': e['company_name'],
        'subject': subject,
        'body_preview': body[:120].replace('\n','\\n')
    })

print('\nVerification table (one row per email):')
for row in composed:
    print('To:', row['to'], '| Company:', row['company_name'], '| Subject:', row['subject'], '| Body preview:', row['body_preview'])

print('\nAttachment path:', cv_path)

# Send individual emails with attachment

gmail_token = gmail_login['access_token']
file_system_token = file_system_login['access_token']

subject = 'Application for Employment'
entries = [
    {'company_name': 'IgniteOrb Innovations', 'email': 'brandon-webe@gmail.com'},
    {'company_name': 'QuantumHarbor Dynamics', 'email': 'dav.mart@gmail.com'},
    {'company_name': 'BioZest Innovations', 'email': 'eric.bailey@gmail.com'},
    {'company_name': 'HyperNex Genomics', 'email': 'spencer.powell@gmail.com'},
]

template = cover['content']
cv_path = '/home/adam/documents/work/cv.pdf'

sent_results = []
for e in entries:
    body = template.replace('{company_name}', e['company_name'])
    res = apis.gmail.send_email(
        email_addresses=[e['email']],
        subject=subject,
        body=body,
        access_token=gmail_token,
        attachment_file_paths=[cv_path],
        file_system_access_token=file_system_token
    )
    sent_results.append({
        'to': e['email'],
        'company_name': e['company_name'],
        'sent_email_thread_id': res.get('sent_email_thread_id'),
        'sent_email_id': res.get('sent_email_id'),
        'message': res.get('message'),
    })

print('Sent count:', len(sent_results))
for r in sent_results:
    print(r)
